subject: Backup expunge window and DR run — EU residency & legalhold interplay
messages:
From: Timothy Blake <timothy.blake@finbank.com>
To: monica_patel@redwood.com
Cc: FinBank Security <security@finbank.com>, lena.kwon@finbank.com
Date: Mon, 02 Nov 2026 09:12:00 +0000
Subject: Questions on backup expunge timing and DR run impact

Hi Monica,

Quick question from the FinBank DR team ahead of our November exercise: we saw the note in the onboarding docs that backups are subject to a per-region expunge TTL after snapshot expiration. If we kick a DR run that triggers snapshot promotion/retention changes in the EU region, can you confirm whether the expunge (physical deletion) job will respect ongoing legal holds or in-flight restores?

Specifically:
- If a snapshot is marked for deletion due to policy (30d retention) but then is selected as part of a DR restore within that window, will the expunge be postponed?
- How long is the internal expunge delay after a snapshot is marked expired? Is it synchronous across region replicas or staggered?
- We also have a regulatory legal-hold request that could arrive mid-week; what's your recommended safe guard for preserves during a DR cutover?

We're trying to finalize the DR run playbook and need clear guarantees for our compliance team.

Thanks,
Tim
DR Operations Manager
FinBank
From: monica_patel@redwood.com <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Timothy Blake <timothy.blake@finbank.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com, aditya_rao@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 02 Nov 2026 13:28:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Questions on backup expunge timing and DR run impact

Timothy — thanks for the clear questions. I pulled engineering and our Compliance PM into thread (CC'd) so we can give an operational answer and a recommended MAP for your DR run. Short answers up front:

- If a snapshot is selected for restore BEFORE the physical expunge job completes, the snapshot will be retained and the expunge will be cancelled for that object. Restores implicitly renew the object for the restore workflow.
- The expunge pipeline runs in two phases: a regional tombstone phase (marking objects expired) and a deferred physical expunge that runs in a configurable window. Default deferred expunge is 48 hours after tombstone; replicas in paired regions are scheduled to avoid simultaneous expunge where possible.
- Legal-hold requests override scheduled expunge immediately when applied via the control plane — we recommend applying holds prior to DR exercises if there is any possibility a hold could be required.

I'm attaching a short DR plan with the suggested carve-outs for retention and a snapshot-retention-matrix that maps behaviors per storage class (attached). We'll propose a brief change to your playbook to ensure holds are set ahead of cutover.

Next steps: 1) Karthik — can you confirm the expunge window behavior for EU-West replicas and whether we can extend the deferred expunge to 7 days for FinBank during the scheduled exercise? 2) Marissa — I'll propose the MAP to FinBank and coordinate the timing.

Best,
Monica Patel
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference

Attachments: dr_run_plan_v2.pdf (PDF, 360KB), snapshot-retention-matrix.csv (CSV, 4KB)
From: karthik_iyer@redwood.com <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>

Date: Tue, 03 Nov 2026 08:07:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Questions on backup expunge timing and DR run impact

Hi team — technical confirmation from infra:

1) Expunge pipeline details: When retention TTL expires we write a tombstone marker. Physical expunge is after a delayed window (default 48h) and works via region-coordinated workers. If any worker sees the object referenced by an active restore or a legal hold flag, it skips expunge for that object on all replicas and clears the tombstone.

2) Replica timing: To minimize race, we schedule expunge staggered across paired regions by up to 4 hours and include a final cross-check (metadata quorum) before removal. This avoids the rare case of both replicas expunged if a late restore starts.

3) Temporary extension: We can configure a customer-scoped expunge-delay override. For scheduled DR runs we have a standard play: set-expunge-delay=7d for the account starting 24h before the run; release the override 72h after the run completes (or on sign-off). We will implement the override as an account-scoped flag that your security team can read-only verify.

I'll create the infra change under SUP-4782 to gate the override and to add a readout into the Console (account > retention).

—Karthik
Principal Infrastructure Engineer
Redwood Inference

- For the account-scoped flag, can FinBank have a partner read-only view in the Console so our security ops can verify the 7d override is active without the ability to modify it?

If you can provide the MAP we can sign off on the schedule by EOD Friday.

Regards,
Tim

Subject: Re: Questions on backup expunge timing and DR run impact — Proposed MAP and evidence checklist

Timothy — attaching the proposed mutual action plan below in the body with exact steps and the evidence artifacts we will provide. I've also uploaded the small artifacts to the shared Drive link (see metadata). If you and your compliance lead are happy, Marissa will generate the account-level change order and we can schedule the expunge-delay override for the run window.

Mutual Action Plan (summary):
1) T-48h: Redwood sets account-scoped expunge-delay override = 7d and flags read-only view granted to FinBank Security. (Artifact: override-change-event ID + timestamp)
2) T-24h: Redwood runs a pre-check report listing all snapshots in scope and tombstone statuses. (Artifact: pre-check CSV snapshot-retention-matrix.csv)
3) DR Cutover Day: If any snapshot is restored, the restore job will cancel tombstones for those objects and the pre-check + restore logs will show renewed retention. (Artifact: restore-job.log with IDs)
4) T+72h: Redwood runs post-check. If no late legal-hold was applied, we release override and record expunge decisions. (Artifacts: post-check report, expunge-decision log)
5) If FinBank requests a legal hold at any time, Redwood will immediately apply a hold flag and cancel pending expunge; we will produce an audit entry for the hold. (Artifact: legal-hold event + audit trace)

Audit evidence we will provide: override-change-event export, pre/post-check CSVs, restore-job logs, expunge-decision log entries (per-object), and a console readout screenshot for the read-only view.

Next steps: Marissa — I'll hand over the MAP and required wording for the change order. Timothy — please confirm acceptance and the exact DR window (start/end UTC) and who on your side will verify the read-only view.

Thanks — happy to jump on a 30m call if you prefer a live walkthrough before sign-off.

Best,
Monica Patel
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
